snippet.title: Potato Please Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Potato Please Official Reveal Trailer

A first-person potato peeling game. You have a knife. You have a bucket. You have a mountain of potatoes. Peel them with real physics. Cut thin, waste nothing. Buy better tools. Finish the pile.

Wishlist Potato Please on Steam:
